<?php
class NullableTrueGet {
    public function __get(string $incoming): ?true {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "nil") { return null; }
        if ($incoming === "bad") { return 1; }
        return true;
    }
}
class UnionTrueGet {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): true|null {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "nil") { return null; }
        if ($incoming === "bad") { return false; }
        return true;
    }
}
class UnionFalseGet {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): null|false {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "nil") { return null; }
        if ($incoming === "bad") { return 0; }
        return false;
    }
}
$nullable = new NullableTrueGet;
$truth = new UnionTrueGet;
$falsehood = new UnionFalseGet;
$selector = "nil";
echo $nullable->$selector === null ? "TN;" : "BAD_TN;";
echo $nullable->value === true ? "TV;" : "BAD_TV;";
echo $truth->nil === null ? "UN;" : "BAD_UN;";
echo $truth->value === true ? "UV;" : "BAD_UV;";
echo $falsehood->nil === null ? "FN;" : "BAD_FN;";
echo $falsehood->value === false ? "FV;" : "BAD_FV;";
echo $nullable->echo;
echo ";";
$falsehood->drop;
echo "DROP;";
$destination = 42;
try {
    $destination = $nullable->bad === true;
} catch (TypeError $firstFailure) {
    echo $firstFailure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP_T;" : "BAD_STORE_T;";
try {
    $destination = $truth->bad === true;
} catch (TypeError $secondFailure) {
    echo $secondFailure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP_U;" : "BAD_STORE_U;";
try {
    $destination = $falsehood->bad === false;
} catch (TypeError $thirdFailure) {
    echo $thirdFailure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP_F;" : "BAD_STORE_F;";
echo $selector === "nil" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_SELECTOR;";
echo "DONE;";
